sentences.text: "10.1 That, this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to call the records pertaining to the case from the respondent authorities.

10.2 That, this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to issue an appropriate writ,
thereby directing the respondent authorities to compute and pay the land compensation as per present market value of acquired lands of petitioner in view of provisions of Act, 2013, with interest from the date of award of compensation to the actual payment of compensation as defined under Section 80 of Act, 2013."
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is owner of land bearing khasra No.930/1, 938/1 & 939/3.

The land owned by the petitioner was acquired by the respondents and award in this regard was also passed on 18.6.2015 calculating the amount of compensation,
however, till date the amount of compensation is not paid to the petitioner and therefore, petitioner submitted representations before the Collector from time to time, lastly in the month of February,
2024.
However, the Collector is sitting over the representations of petitioner and is not taking any decision on the same.
Therefore, a direction be issued to respondent No. 3 to take decision on the representation/application submitted by the petitioner for disbursement of the amount of compensation.

3. Learned State counsel submits that as petitioner is not pressing this writ petition on merit and only seeking a direction to respondent No.3 to decide his pending representation/application, he is having no objection.
4. I have heard learned counsel for the parties.

5. Taking into consideration the nature of grievance raised, submission of counsel for petitioner that land of petitioner, an agriculturist, was acquired and award was also passed in the year 2015, but till date compensation is not paid to the petitioner, I am of the view that no purpose would be served in keeping this writ petition pending, awaiting reply from the respondents and the ends of justice will be served if this writ petition is disposed of at this stage directing respondents to take decision on representation.
6.

Accordingly, this writ petition is disposed of with a direction to respondent No.3 to take decision on the application submitted by the petitioner in accordance with law expeditiously, preferably within a period of 4 months from the date of receipt of the order passed by this Court.

Sd/-
